title: Flood Fill
description: An image is represented by an `m x n` integer grid `image` where `image[i][j]` represents the pixel value. You are given `sr`, `sc`, and `color`. Perform a flood fill on the image starting from `(sr, sc)` replacing the starting pixel and all 4-directionally connected pixels of the same color with `color`.

hints.content: Check if the target pixel already has the new color (avoid infinite loop).
DFS to all 4 neighbors matching originalColor, setting them to color.

solution.explanation:
Standard flood fill via DFS traversal. Replaces original color with target color on adjacent cells.
Time Complexity: O(m * n)
Space Complexity: O(m * n)
